description: Returns a time-ordered list of correlated events on one server over a look-back window — service crashes, error and warning spikes in the logs, CPU/memory/disk thresholds crossed, SSL certificates nearing expiry, and newly detected issues — with the likely root cause when one is identified.
name: get_incident_timeline

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

caused_by.description: Id of the event this one is attributed to, when a cause was identified.

id.description: Event id, unique within the timeline.

type.description: Event type: service_crash, error_spike, warning_spike, metric_threshold, ssl_expiry, recommendation or similar.

root_cause.description: The event the others are attributed to, or null.

caused_by.description: Id of the event this one is attributed to, when a cause was identified.

id.description: Event id, unique within the timeline.

type.description: Event type: service_crash, error_spike, warning_spike, metric_threshold, ssl_expiry, recommendation or similar.

window_end.description: End of the look-back window, ISO 8601.

window_start.description: Start of the look-back window, ISO 8601.

title: Incident timeline
